findings.title: Current XRD README retains an unmarked superseded DOC range
evidence: xrd/README.md:102 states an absolute DOC range of 46–60%, while :31 and :297 state 49–65%; :366–367 records that the current background-model correction shifted 46–60% to 49–65%, but :102 is unmarked.

xrd/results/summary_metrics.csv records Degree of crystallinity as 49.03075193872934–65.21878625874905%. An isolated recomputation from the committed raw scan and .mdi sidecar with xrd_protocol_kernel.analyse_single returned 49.030543–65.218597%.

reproduce: python3 -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"xrd/analysis"); import xrd_protocol_kernel as k; txt="xrd/data/raw/generations-0726/perovskite_control__20260726-095651_100.txt"; h=k.read_mdi_header(txt[:-4]+".mdi"); m=k.scan_meta(wavelength=h["wavelength"],step=h["step"],dwell=h["dwell"],tth_range=(h["start"],h["end"]),instrument=h["instrument"],label="control"); r=k.analyse_single(txt,meta=m,nmc=20,n_boot=250,calibrate=True,substrate_tth=[30.05]); print("DOC=%.6f–%.6f%%" % r["crystallinity"]["doc_range"])'; sed -n '97,116p;294,299p;360,368p' xrd/README.md

proposed_check: C-XRD-DOC-001 — recompute the control DOC range from the committed raw .txt/.mdi with xrd_protocol_kernel, then require every unmarked DOC range in xrd/README.md to agree after documented rounding; a fixture retaining unmarked 46–60% when the derivation yields 49–65% must fail.

verified_closed_findings.verification_summary: In an isolated clean clone, derive_q3.py and an independent raw-output parser both produced VBM-referenced +75.8 meV, semicore-aligned +52.1 meV, and semicore shift -45.0 meV; P1_REFERENCE_AUDIT.md and Q0_RESOLVED.md carry the normalized values. A deliberate unmarked +75.9 table mutation made regression group 39 fail.

The Q3 index row now declares committed/recomputable q3_raw evidence and retains the prior absent-raw assertion only in an explicit retraction. A repository-wide live-document sweep found no other unmarked legacy absent-raw assertion, and regression group 39 passed at the fixed commit.

summary: BLOCK for publication claims because a current XRD authority document contains an unmarked DOC value contradicted by its raw-data recomputation. F-012 and F-013 are independently verified closed.

coverage.method: Enumerated all tracked paths at the fixed commit, then content-audited current indices, authority reports, protocols, manifests, Q3/XRD raw data and derivations, plus isolated clean-clone executions and targeted repository-wide sweeps.
not_examined: No line-by-line semantic review of every historical archive, literature PDF, proposal PDF, or image binary was performed.
No full independent re-execution of every MLIP/DFT production workflow or every XRD passivator-series analysis was performed; high-impact Q3, Objective 2, and control-XRD claims were targeted.
